title: Senior Content Writer
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

**SunTec India is looking for an experienced Content Writer with 3\+ years of experience creating SEO\-drivencontent for IT Services and B2B audiences. The ideal candidate should be able to simplify complex technologyand business concepts into engaging, informative, and conversion\-focused content for a global audienc**e.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

■ Create SEO\-optimized content for service pages, landing pages, blogs, case studies, white papers, andwebsite content

.■ Develop long\-form and pillar content to improve organic visibility and topical authority.

■ **Write about IT Services, eCommerce, digital commerce, and technology trends.**

■ Conduct keyword research and optimize content based on search intent and content gaps.

■ Optimize content for SEO, GEO, AEO, and AI\-powered search experiences.

■ Create content for guest posts and off\-page SEO initiatives, with an understanding of do\-follow andno\-follow links.

■ Collaborate with SEO, marketing, and business teams to align content with business goals.

■ Proofread, edit, and update existing content to maintain quality and improve performance

**REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

■ 3\+ years of professional content writing experience.

**■IT Services/B2B content writing experience is mandatory.**

■ Strong understanding of SEO, keyword research, content optimization, and search intent

■ Excellent command of English, grammar, proofreading, and editing.

■ Ability to simplify complex technical topics for business audiences.

■ Practical knowledge of guest posting, backlinking, and off\-page SEO.

■ Understanding of GEO and AEO is mandatory.

■ Familiarity with ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or other AI tools.

■ Knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, or Ahrefs is an advantage.

■ Strong research skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

**HOW TO APPLY**

**Interested candidates can share their updated CV at shakun@suntecindia.com or contact 9266908805\.**

***Apply only if you have relevant IT Services/B2B content writing experience.***

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹65,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Video Editor
description:
**Job Description – Video Editor**

**Location: Kirti Nagar, New Delhi**

**Experience: 2–4 Years**

**Employment Type: Full\-Time**

**About TransCurators**

TransCurators is a leading content solutions company delivering high\-quality Content,

Editorial, Localization, Translation, Publishing, Digital Content, E\-learning, Creative

Services, and Video Production solutions to global enterprises, startups, and EdTech

organizations. We create engaging visual content for brands across corporate communication,

digital marketing, social media, learning solutions, and advertising.

As our creative services continue to grow, we are looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented

Video Editor who can transform raw footage into compelling visual stories while

maintaining the highest standards of creativity, technical excellence, and brand consistency.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly creative, technically proficient, and execution\-focused Video

Editor to manage end\-to\-end post\-production for a wide variety of video projects.

The Video Editor will be responsible for assembling raw footage into polished, engaging, and visually compelling content by combining storytelling, editing techniques, sound design, motion graphics, colour grading, and visual effects. The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of narrative flow, pacing, audience engagement, and platform\-specific content optimization.

This role requires close collaboration with Video Producers, Motion Graphic Designers, Creative Teams, Account Managers, and Clients to ensure every video meets creative expectations, business objectives, and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Video Editing \& Storytelling**

 Edit raw footage into compelling and engaging videos while maintaining the intended

narrative and creative vision.

 Understand project objectives, target audience, brand guidelines, and client

expectations before editing.

 Structure content to maximize viewer engagement and storytelling effectiveness.

 Create edits for:

o Corporate Films

o Brand Videos

o Social Media Content

o Advertisements

o Product Videos

o Explainer Videos

o Training \& E\-learning Videos

o Event Videos

o Interviews

o Testimonials

o Promotional Videos

o Podcasts \& Webinars

o Reels, Shorts \& YouTube Videos

o AI Videos

 Ensure logical sequencing and smooth transitions between scenes.

**2\. Post\-Production Management**

 Perform complete post\-production activities including:

o Rough Cut

o Fine Cut

o Final Cut

o Colour Correction

o Colour Grading

o Audio Cleanup

o Sound Mixing

o Background Music Integration

o Noise Reduction

o Subtitle Integration

o Captioning

o Video Compression

o Export Optimization

 Maintain organized project files and editing timelines.

**3\. Motion Graphics \& Visual Enhancements**

 Integrate motion graphics, lower thirds, transitions, typography, animations, and

visual effects.

 Add brand\-compliant graphics and animations.

 Create engaging intros, outros, title animations, and call\-to\-action sequences.

 Collaborate with Motion Graphic Designers for advanced animation requirements.

 Ensure visual consistency throughout the video.

**4\. Audio Editing \& Enhancement**

 Clean and enhance audio quality.

 Synchronize voiceovers with visuals.

 Balance dialogue, background music, and sound effects.

 Remove unwanted background noise.

 Ensure professional audio quality across all deliverables.

**5\. Colour Grading \& Visual Quality**

 Perform colour correction and cinematic colour grading.

 Match colour profiles across multiple camera sources.

 Ensure visual consistency across shots.

 Improve lighting and exposure where required.

 Deliver visually appealing content aligned with brand identity.

**6\. Collaboration \& Creative Execution**

 Work closely with:

o Video Producers

o Creative Team

o Motion Graphic Designers

o Account Managers

o Clients

o Production Team

 Understand creative briefs before beginning edits.

 Participate in creative discussions and brainstorming sessions.

 Incorporate client and internal feedback efficiently.

 Maintain effective communication throughout project execution.

**7\. Quality Assurance \& Final Delivery**

 Conduct detailed quality checks before final exports.

 Verify:

o Video Resolution

o Audio Levels

o Typography

o Graphics

o Branding

o Colour Accuracy

o Subtitle Accuracy

o Motion Graphics

o Export Settings

 Ensure error\-free final deliveries.

 Prepare multiple export versions for different platforms.

**8\. Asset \&; Project Management**

 Maintain proper folder structures and project organization.

 Archive completed projects systematically.

 Manage stock footage, music libraries, templates, fonts, and editing assets.

 Ensure proper version control throughout editing cycles.

 Maintain backup copies of all production files.

9\. Platform Optimization

 Edit videos according to platform\-specific best practices for:

o YouTube

o Instagram

o LinkedIn

o Facebook

o X (Twitter)

o TikTok

o Learning Management Systems (LMS)

o Corporate Portals

 Optimize aspect ratios, durations, subtitles, and formats for different platforms.

 Ensure videos are optimized for engagement and audience retention.

**10\. Process Improvement \& Innovation**

 Stay updated with latest editing trends, AI tools, and post\-production technologies.

 Recommend innovative editing techniques to improve content quality.

 Develop reusable editing templates and workflows.

 Build standardized editing practices to improve productivity.

 Continuously improve post\-production efficiency.

Cross\-Functional Coordination

Work closely with:

 Head of Operations

 Video Producer

 Account Management Team

 Project Managers

 Creative Designers

 Motion Graphic Designers

 Content Writers

 Production Crew

 Clients

 External Vendors

 Leadership Team

**Operational Authority**

 Ownership of assigned video editing projects from raw footage to final delivery.

 Authority to recommend creative improvements during post\-production.

 Responsibility for maintaining editing quality and technical excellence.

 Ownership of project timelines during post\-production.

 Authority to coordinate revisions with Video Producers and stakeholders.

 Responsibility for maintaining organized project files and archives.

 Escalate editing challenges, technical issues, and delivery risks to leadership.

Pay: ₹20,313\.62 \- ₹40,732\.70 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Content Writer cum Social Media Manager
description:
Womennovator intends to engage Content writer cum Social Media Manager on the following terms and conditions:
  

  

**Job responsibilities:** We need a content writer cum social media manager who will help in content creation, managing content on the website, and maintaining different social media platforms. The manager will develop and implement a Womennovator social media strategy, develop brand awareness, generate inbound traffic to social media platforms, and websites.
  

* Content Creation (Large and Technical) for the Womennovator’s website and social media platforms.
* Proofreading and editing.
* Content creation for Media (Print, Broadcast, and Digital)
* Managing social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Blogs, YouTube, LinkedIn), overseeing design (Facebook timeline cover pic, display ads, thumbnails, ads, profile pic, YouTube branding, Twitter profile, Instagram stories, and feed, and other theme\-based events branding), overseeing day to day social media activity (addressing queries, concerns, flagging inappropriate comments and posts, writing and scheduling daily posts, etc.).
* Help in the promotion (campaign planning and execution), create a unique voice for the brand on social media and Womennovator website and generate relevant content (on all social and online forums) to reach the audience most likely to engage with Womennovator.
* Develop a strategy to promote externally funded projects, executive education, in\-house activities (seminars and workshops), and outbound events.
* Implement Search Engine Optimization (SEOs) for the website and Social Media.
* Using analytics (Google, Facebook, and other social media management tool) for effective social media presence and positive brand image of Womennovator.
* Maintain database for Womennovator \& create and control the content calendar for several accounts across platforms, as well as the key influencer and stakeholders that touch them, both internally and externally.
* Liaise with internal teams such as clubs, committees, cells, programs, externally funded projects, theme\-based events, etc., for content creation and management. Liaise with in\-house designers and photographers, to produce creative assets and to share on different media channels.

  

**Womennovator Required qualifications:**
  

* An M.A. degree in Mass Communication and Journalism or English or Media Studies or New Media Communication or Creative Writing or MBA in Marketing or Media Management.
* 3\+ years of Social Media Marketing experience in corporate marketing, education the sector, social sector, or agency marketing role. Knowledge of Internet Marketing, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), and Web Development are desirable.
* Verifiable examples of social media marketing successes on different platforms \- Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest, Google\+, YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram.
* Expert level skills in using and navigating social media networks, native web apps, 3rd party social media tools.
* Candidate must possess good writing skills and the ability to visualize and convey a message with interesting and relevant content.
